subject: Every string the editor.event_list surface exposes to AX in zh-CN
question: What labels does Logic show on editor.event_list in zh-CN, and on which elements?

reverify.expected: a census in zh-CN whose editor.event_list rows carry the same 57 distinct strings; a differing set means Logic's labels moved and every provenance citing this record wants re-reading
reverify.cost: ~1 min with Logic open on the fixture project in that locale

method: Read, never actuated. The menu bar and every menu were walked without opening them; the main window was walked to depth 8. Each element with any string became one row of the evidence file; rows were assigned to this surface by what their path or help text passes through, and rows no rule could place are counted in limits rather than filed.

strings: MIDI 输入   ⌥I, “MIDI 输入”按钮. 点按以将音符添加到现有 MIDI 片段，或连按以使用音乐键入键盘或外部 MIDI 键盘更改 MIDI 片段中所选音符的音高/力度。
MIDI 输出   ⌥O, “MIDI 输出”按钮. 在点按、选定或使用 MIDI 编辑器添加时播放 MIDI 事件。
显示复音触后事件, “复音触后”按钮. 显示或隐藏复音触后事件，这些事件由音乐键盘上的机械压力传感器生成。用来调制声音。
显示弯音事件, “弯音”按钮. 显示或隐藏弯音事件，这些事件由键盘上的弯音轮生成。用来变化音高。
显示控制改变事件, “控制器”按钮. 显示或隐藏控制更改事件。用来将 MIDI 控制器数据传输到软件乐器或外部 MIDI 键盘和模块。
显示系统专用事件, 系统“专用”按钮. 显示或隐藏系统专用事件。
显示触后事件, “触后”按钮. 显示或隐藏触后事件，这些事件由音乐键盘上的机械压力传感器生成。用来调制声音。
显示附加信息, “附加简介”按钮. 显示或隐藏与事件或片段一同储存的所有信息（例如音符事件的释键力度）。
显示音符事件, “音符”按钮. 显示或隐藏音符事件。用来播放软件乐器和外部 MIDI 声音模块或键盘。
显示音色变化事件, 音色“变化”按钮. 显示或隐藏音色变化事件。用来选择 Patch，方法是将它们传输到相连接的 MIDI 设备。

conclusion: On this host in zh-CN, editor.event_list exposes 105 elements carrying 57 distinct strings. Every string is in the evidence file verbatim, which is what lets a label variant cite this record: the guard requires the string to occur in the observations or evidence, and here it does or it does not.
limits: Navigation-free surfaces only: nothing behind a menu press or a button was opened, so this says nothing about the mixer, plug-in editors or the editors.

9 window-level rows (the title bar, its close/minimise/zoom buttons and the unnamed containers directly under the window) belong to no area and are filed under no record; 0 further window rows matched no area rule. All are in the evidence file.
One project, one host, one build. A label that depends on project content — a track name, a region name — is a reading of this fixture, not of Logic.

1 strings are neither cited nor proved absent: each is absent from Apple's corpora as bytes and a shipped label folds to it (a colon, an ellipsis, a case), so the spelling Logic ships is not something this census read: 1 1 1 1
